protocol_provenance.type: operator-supplied working design, attributed to Rob Smith
protocol_provenance.scope: Ticket pool, commitments, two audits and ten distinct partitions, hidden expected counts, durable pending states, small-miner trust limits, Gold epoch and difficulty objective. Proposals, not production guarantees.

sources.title: PGN project presentation
sources.author: Rob Smith’s initiative · PGN contributors
sources.purpose: The public introduction, background, credit, and development objectives. Earlier reservation language is not a final ticket protocol.

sources.title: Prime Gap Scout
sources.author: Prime Gap Scout contributors
sources.purpose: The separate CUDA searcher: supported ranges, releases, checkpoints, endpoint verification, and explicit coverage limits.

sources.title: Scout validation record
sources.author: Prime Gap Scout contributors
sources.purpose: Read the distinction between compilation, physical execution, and application validation before interpreting a software claim.

sources.title: Prime Gap List Project
sources.author: Prime Gap List Project maintainers
sources.purpose: A community-maintained route into tables, graphs, terminology, and the legacy first-occurrence record. This is an external project.

sources.title: How to read a gap table
sources.author: Thomas R. Nicely · preserved by the Prime Gap List Project
sources.purpose: Nicely’s original rubric explains merit, status distinctions, abbreviations, and the evidence behind table entries. Historical submission details may be obsolete.

sources.title: Record gap lengths · A005250
sources.author: OEIS Foundation and sequence contributors
sources.purpose: The sequence of record gaps between consecutive primes. Pair it with A002386 to connect lengths to their lower endpoints.

sources.title: Where record gaps begin · A002386
sources.author: OEIS Foundation and sequence contributors
sources.purpose: Primes whose following gap exceeds every previous gap. Useful for checking small examples and the exact meaning of “record.”

sources.title: Sieve of Eratosthenes
sources.author: PrimePages
sources.purpose: The classical sieve: remove multiples of small primes. Supports the teaching lab; it does not certify a different large-integer search implementation.

sources.title: The Gaps Between Primes
sources.author: PrimePages
sources.purpose: An introduction to prime gaps and numerical evidence. Note its convention: several tables count interior composites rather than endpoint distance.

sources.title: Prime-gap research FAQ
sources.author: Prime Gap List Project maintainers
sources.purpose: Background on the community list and the differences among early instances, records, and exhaustive searches.

sources.title: Large gaps between consecutive prime numbers
sources.author: Kevin Ford, Ben Green, Sergei Konyagin & Terence Tao · 2016
sources.purpose: A research paper on asymptotic lower bounds for the largest gaps below a bound. Numerical searches do not replace these unbounded statements.

sources.title: Combined Sieve Algorithm for Prime Gaps
sources.author: Seth Troisi · 2020
sources.purpose: A computational paper describing how sieve work can be shared across candidate intervals. A targeted-search method, not a PGN implementation guarantee.

sources.title: The large-gap problem, explained by an author
sources.author: Terence Tao · 2014
sources.purpose: An author’s mathematical discussion of large gaps, composite runs, and why the asymptotic question is different from finding individual examples.

sources.title: Exploring the mysteries of the Prime (gaps!) Line.
sources.author: Matt Parker · Stand-up Maths
sources.purpose: An accessible visual exploration of prime-gap patterns. A friendly starting point before reading research tables. Opens on YouTube; no third-party player loads here.

sources.title: Large Gaps between Primes
sources.author: James Maynard · Numberphile
sources.purpose: A short Numberphile interview with James Maynard, introducing large gaps and why they matter. Opens on YouTube.

sources.title: The original Gapcoin discussion
sources.author: Gapcoin community · BitcoinTalk · 2014 onward
sources.purpose: The historical announcement and ensuing discussion of a separate prime-gap cryptocurrency. Read dated posts as historical claims, not PGN specifications.

sources.title: Gapcoin developer’s technical posts
sources.author: j0nn9 · preserved by Graham Higgins
sources.purpose: Date-sorted BitcoinTalk explanations of Gapcoin’s sieve, verification, and parameters. Historical design assertions, not PGN rules or a modern correctness certificate.

sources.title: Graham Higgins’s Gapcoin community resource
sources.author: Graham Higgins and Gapcoin Project contributors
sources.purpose: An archive spanning mathematics, mining, software, posts, and videos. Consulted for the breadth of community resources; its prose and visual design are not reused.

literary_easter_egg.title: Been A Long, Long Time
literary_easter_egg.author: R. A. Lafferty
literary_easter_egg.type: Fiction; discreet footer reference, not mathematical or PGN evidence

artwork: Original native SVG, exact small-integer sieve mission, session-map illustrations, Canvas cinematic study, and browser code; no external imagery, audio, or video embeds.
